tokens-theme.focus: every token value against tokens.json for BOTH themes (standby and alert), including glows (ring, blur, alpha), the ramp (color-mix percentages used by .kk-heat / .kk-wf in bundle.css), scrims; breakpoints, column counts and margins against the layout / breakpoint tokens and the .kk-grid / .kk-screen CSS; the named type scale against tokens.json (size, line-height, weight, letter-spacing in em converted to px); copyWith / == / hashCode completeness; font family and fallback resolution with and without a package; InheritedWidget updateShouldNotify and KkConditionScope.
